title: Top 5 Bridal Blouse Sleeve Trends for Upcoming Wedding Season
author: Kaviya S (Lead Designer)
excerpt: Discover the most sought-after Aari embroidery sleeve patterns — from peacock motif cutwork to dense Kundan stone waterfalls.
content:

2. Grand Peacock & Floral Zardosi Motifs
3. Dense Sugar Bead & Pearl Waterfall Rows
4. Temple Architecture Border Sequences
5. 3D Silk Thread Flower Accents

title: Ranipet District Aari Federation: Empowering Local Embroidery Artisans
author: Kaviya S (Joint Secretary)

content: As Joint Secretary of Ranipet District for the Indian Aari Work Federation, Kaviya S led an inspiring session on expanding handloom and needlework workshops. The federation continues to set benchmarks with World Record events and official certification courses.

title: How to Care for & Store Your Hand-Embroidered Silk Zari Blouses
author: Sangee Sri Studio
excerpt: Essential preservation tips to keep your Kundan stones sparkling and pure zari threads untarnished for generations.
content:
Handcrafted Aari blouses are heirloom treasures. Here are essential care tips from our studio:

• Always dry clean hand-embroidered silk blouses.
• Store wrapped in pure muslin cotton cloth.
• Avoid spraying perfume directly on zari and Kundan stones.
• Keep away from moisture and direct sunlight.
